item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q07","reason":"Preaggregate pickup counts before the left join, preserving duplicate zone matches and NULL borough groups. Cast the weighted total to BIGINT to match COUNT(*).","sql":"WITH pickups AS (SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID) SELECT z.Borough AS borough, CAST(SUM(p.n) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM pickups p LEFT JOIN zones z ON p.PULocationID = z.LocationID GROUP BY z.Borough"},{"query_id":"q08","reason":"Replace the rolling AVG window with an ordinal range join over observed days. Preserve DATE values, the NULL day group, anomalous dates, partial frames, and AVG's DOUBLE result.","sql":"WITH daily AS (SELECT CAST(tpep_pickup_datetime AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1), numbered AS (SELECT day, trips, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY day ASC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM daily) SELECT a.day AS day, AVG(b.trips) AS rolling FROM numbered a JOIN numbered b ON b.rn BETWEEN a.rn - 2 AND a.rn GROUP BY a.day"}]}
